dialog.text:
Hi! Welcome to our BIKE SHOP.

Have we got just the BIKE for you!

It's a cool BIKE! Do you want it?
Sorry! You can't afford it!
Come back again some time!

Oh, that's...

A BIKE VOUCHER!

OK! Here you go!

RED exchanged the BIKE VOUCHER for a BICYCLE.
dialog.trigger: With the Bike Voucher, he gives you the Bicycle

dialog.text: You better make room for this!

How do you like your new BICYCLE?

You can take it on CYCLING ROAD and in caves!

A plain city BIKE is good enough for me!

You can't put a shopping basket on an MTB!
These BIKEs are cool, but they're way expensive!
Wow. Your BIKE is really cool!

Hiya! I'm a POKéMON... ...No I'm not!

Call me BILL! I'm a true blue POKéMANIAC! Hey! What's with that skeptical look?

I'm not joshing you, I screwed up an experiment and got combined with a POKéMON!

So, how about it? Help me out here!
When I'm in the TELEPORTER, go to my PC and run the Cell Separation System!

No!? Come on, you gotta help a guy in deep trouble!

What do you say, chief? Please? OK? All right!

When I'm in the TELEPORTER, go to my PC and run the Cell Separation System!

BILL: Yeehah! Thanks, bud! I owe you one!

So, did you come to see my POKéMON collection? You didn't? That's a bummer.

I've got to thank you... Oh here, maybe this'll do.
dialog.trigger: After you run the Cell Separation System, he gives you the S.S. Ticket

dialog.text: You've got too much stuff, bud!

That cruise ship, S.S.ANNE, is in VERMILION CITY. Its passengers are all trainers!

They invited me to their party, but I can't stand fancy do's. Why don't you go instead of me?
dialog.trigger: After you get the S.S. Ticket

dialog.text: BILL: Look, bud, just check out some of my rare POKéMON on my PC!
dialog.trigger: Later, he moves to his PC

dialog.text: Hi RED! BLUE is out at Grandpa's lab.
Grandpa asked you to run an errand? Here, this will help you!
dialog.trigger: After you get the Pokédex, she gives you the Town Map

dialog.text: You have too much stuff with you.
dialog.trigger: If your bag is full when she offers the Town Map

dialog.text: Use the TOWN MAP to find out where you are.
dialog.trigger: After you get the Town Map

dialog.text: POKéMON are living things! If they get tired, give them a rest!
dialog.trigger: Once you come back later, she gets up and walks around

dialog.text:
POKéMON BADGEs are owned only by skilled trainers.

I see you have at least one.

Those BADGEs have amazing secrets!

Now then...

Which of the 8 BADGEs should I describe?

The ATTACK of all POKéMON increases a little bit.

It also lets you use FLASH any time you desire.
dialog.trigger: If you pick the Boulder Badge

dialog.text:
POKéMON up to L30 will obey you.

Any higher, they become unruly!

It also lets you use CUT outside of battle.
dialog.trigger: If you pick the Cascade Badge

dialog.text:
The SPEED of all POKéMON increases a little bit.

It also lets you use FLY outside of battle.
dialog.trigger: If you pick the Thunder Badge

dialog.text:
POKéMON up to L50 will obey you.

Any higher, they become unruly!

It also lets you use STRENGTH out-side of battle.
dialog.trigger: If you pick the Rainbow Badge

dialog.text:
The DEFENSE of all POKéMON increases a little bit.

It also lets you use SURF outside of battle.
dialog.trigger: If you pick the Soul Badge

dialog.text:
POKéMON up to L70 will obey you.

Any higher, they become unruly!
dialog.trigger: If you pick the Marsh Badge

dialog.text: Your POKéMON's SPECIAL abilities increase a bit.
dialog.trigger: If you pick the Volcano Badge

dialog.text: All POKéMON will obey you!
dialog.trigger: If you pick the Earth Badge

dialog.text: Come visit me any time you wish.
You're a trainer too? Collecting, fighting, it's a tough life.

That bush in front of the shop is in the way.

There might be a way around.
You're making an encyclopedia on POKéMON? That sounds amusing.
OK! SLOWBRO! Use SONICBOOM! Come on, SLOWBRO pay attention!
SLOWBRO punch! No! You blew it again!

SLOWBRO, WITHDRAW! No! That's wrong!

It's so hard to control POKéMON!

Your POKéMON's obedience depends on your abilities as a trainer!
SLOWBRO took a snooze...
SLOWBRO is loafing around...
SLOWBRO turned away...
SLOWBRO ignored orders...

I want a bright red BICYCLE!

I'll keep it at home, so it won't get dirty!

This is CERULEAN CAVE! Horribly strong POKéMON live in there!

The POKéMON LEAGUE champion is the only person who is allowed in!
dialog.trigger: Blocks Cerulean Cave until you enter the Hall of Fame

dialog.text:
The people here were robbed.

It's obvious that TEAM ROCKET is behind this most heinous crime!

Even our POLICE force has trouble with the ROCKETs!
dialog.trigger: Guards the door until you visit Bill

dialog.text:
Yo! Champ in making!

Here's my advice!

The LEADER, MISTY, is a pro who uses water POKéMON!

You can drain all their water with plant POKéMON!

Or, zap them with electricity!

You beat MISTY! What'd I tell ya?

You and me kid, we make a pretty darn good team!
Hi there! May I help you?

Use REPEL to keep bugs and weak POKéMON away.

Put your strongest POKéMON at the top of the list for best results!

Have you seen any RARE CANDY?

It's supposed to make POKéMON go up one level!

Welcome to our POKéMON CENTER!

We heal your POKéMON back to perfect health!

Shall we heal your POKéMON?

OK. We'll need your POKéMON.

Thank you! Your POKéMON are fighting fit!

We hope to see you again!
dialog.trigger: If you say yes, she heals your party

dialog.text: We hope to see you again!

That BILL!

I heard that he'll do whatever it takes to get rare POKéMON!

Have you heard about BILL?

Everyone calls him a POKéMANIAC!

I think people are just jealous of BILL, though.

Who wouldn't want to boast about their POKéMON?

This area is reserved for 2 friends who are linked by cable.

Please come again!

My husband likes trading POKéMON.

If you are a collector, would you please trade with him?

Hello there! Do you want to trade

your POLIWHIRL for JYNX?
Well, if you don't want to...

Hmmm? This isn't POLIWHIRL.

Think of me when you get one.
dialog.trigger: If you offer a Pokémon other than Poliwhirl

dialog.text: Thanks!
dialog.trigger: After the trade, you get Jynx nicknamed Lola

dialog.text:
The POLIWHIRL you traded to me

went and evolved!

Those miserable ROCKETs!

Look what they did here!

They stole a TM for teaching POKéMON how to DIG holes!

That cost me a bundle, it did!

I figure what's lost is lost!

I decided to teach DIGLETT how to DIG without a TM!
TEAM ROCKET must be trying to DIG their way into no good!
I run a DAYCARE. Would you like me to raise one of your POKéMON?
Which POKéMON should I raise?

Fine, I'll look after POKéMON for a while.

Come see me in a while.
dialog.trigger: If you leave a Pokémon with him

dialog.text: come again.
You only have one POKéMON with you.
dialog.trigger: If you only have one Pokémon

dialog.text: I can't accept a POKéMON that knows an HM move.
dialog.trigger: If the Pokémon knows an HM

dialog.text:
All right then,

come again.
dialog.trigger: If you cancel, or decline to pay when picking it up

dialog.text:
Your POKéMON has grown a lot!

By level, it's grown by X!

Aren't I great?

You owe me ¥X for the return of this POKéMON.
dialog.trigger: When you come back, if it has grown

dialog.text: Back already? Your POKéMON needs some more time with me.

Thank you! Here's your POKéMON!

RED got POKéMON back!
Hey, you don't have enough ¥!
dialog.trigger: If you don't have enough money

dialog.text: You have no room for this POKéMON!

What a surprise! DIGLETTs dug this long tunnel!

It goes right to VIRIDIAN CITY!

I went to ROCK TUNNEL, but it's dark and scary.

If a POKéMON's FLASH could light it up...
CUBONE: Kyarugoo!

I hate those horrible ROCKETs!

That poor CUBONE's mother...

It was killed trying to escape from TEAM ROCKET!

The GHOST of POKéMON TOWER is gone!

Someone must have soothed its restless soul!
Hi there! May I help you?

I'm searching for items that raise the abilities of POKéMON during a single battle.

X ATTACK, X DEFEND, X SPEED and X SPECIAL are what I'm after.

Do you know where I can get them?
You know REVIVE? It revives any fainted POKéMON!

I found a NUGGET in the mountains.

I thought it was useless, but it sold for ¥5000!

Welcome to our POKéMON CENTER!

We heal your POKéMON back to perfect health!

Shall we heal your POKéMON?

OK. We'll need your POKéMON.

Thank you! Your POKéMON are fighting fit!

We hope to see you again!
dialog.trigger: If you say yes, she heals your party

dialog.text: We hope to see you again!
TEAM ROCKET will do anything for the sake of gold!
I saw CUBONE's mother die trying to escape from TEAM ROCKET!

This area is reserved for 2 friends who are linked by cable.

Please come again!
Do you believe in GHOSTs?
Really? So there are believers...

Hahaha, I guess not.

That white hand on your shoulder, it's not real.

This town is known as the grave site of POKéMON.

Memorial services are held in POKéMON TOWER.

GHOSTs appeared in POKéMON TOWER.

I think they're the spirits of POKéMON that the ROCKETs killed.
That's odd, MR.FUJI isn't here. Where'd he go?
MR.FUJI had been praying alone for CUBONE's mother.

This is really MR.FUJI's house.

He's really kind!

He looks after abandoned and orphaned POKéMON!
It's so warm! POKéMON are so nice to hug!
PSYDUCK: Gwappa!
NIDORINO: Gaoo!

MR.FUJI: RED.

Your POKéDEX quest may fail without love for your POKéMON.

I think this may help your quest.

RED received a POKé FLUTE!

Upon hearing POKé FLUTE, sleeping POKéMON will spring awake.

It works on all sleeping POKéMON.
dialog.trigger: After you rescue him from Pokémon Tower, he gives you the Poké Flute

dialog.text: You must make room for this!
MR.FUJI: Has my FLUTE helped you?
dialog.trigger: After you get the Poké Flute

dialog.text: You want the DOME FOSSIL?
dialog.trigger: After you beat the Super Nerd

dialog.text:
RED got the DOME FOSSIL!

All right. Then this is mine!
dialog.trigger: If you say yes, you get the Dome Fossil and he takes the other one

dialog.text: Look, you've got no room for this.
You want the HELIX FOSSIL?
dialog.trigger: After you beat the Super Nerd

dialog.text:
RED got the HELIX FOSSIL!

All right. Then this is mine!
dialog.trigger: If you say yes, you get the Helix Fossil and he takes the other one

dialog.text: Look, you've got no room for this.

Welcome to our POKéMON CENTER!

We heal your POKéMON back to perfect health!

Shall we heal your POKéMON?

OK. We'll need your POKéMON.

Thank you! Your POKéMON are fighting fit!

We hope to see you again!
dialog.trigger: If you say yes, she heals your party

dialog.text: We hope to see you again!

I've 6 POKé BALLs set in my belt.

At most, you can carry 6 POKéMON.

TEAM ROCKET attacks CERULEAN citizens...

TEAM ROCKET is always in the news!

MAN: Hello, there! Have I got a deal just for you!

I'll let you have a swell MAGIKARP for just ¥500! What do you say?
dialog.trigger: He offers to sell you a Magikarp for ¥500

dialog.text: No? I'm only doing this as a favor to you!
You'll need more money than that!
dialog.trigger: If you don't have enough money

dialog.text: MAN: Well, I don't give refunds!

This area is reserved for 2 friends who are linked by cable.

Please come again!

It's ¥50 for a child's ticket.

Would you like to come in?
dialog.trigger: When you walk up to the counter, he asks for the ¥50 fee

dialog.text: Right, ¥50! Thank you!

You don't have enough money.

Come again!
dialog.trigger: If you don't have enough money

dialog.text: Come again!
Take plenty of time to look!
Please go to the other side!
dialog.trigger: If you talk to him from the side without a ticket

dialog.text:
You can't sneak in the back way!

Oh, whatever! Do you know what AMBER is?
dialog.trigger: If you talk to him from behind the counter

dialog.text: There's a lab somewhere trying to resurrect ancient POKéMON from AMBER.
AMBER is fossil-ized tree sap.
That is one magnificent fossil!

Ssh! I think that this chunk of AMBER contains POKéMON DNA!

It would be great if POKéMON could be resurrected from it!

But, my colleagues just ignore me!

So I have a favor to ask!

Take this to a POKéMON LAB and get it examined!

RED received OLD AMBER!
dialog.trigger: He gives you the Old Amber

dialog.text: You don't have space for this!
Ssh! Get the OLD AMBER checked!
dialog.trigger: After you get the Old Amber

dialog.text: We are proud of 2 fossils of very rare, prehistoric POKéMON!

MOON STONE?

What's so special about it?

July 20, 1969!

The 1st lunar landing!

I bought a color TV to watch it!
We have a space exhibit now.

I want a PIKACHU! It's so cute!

I asked my Daddy to catch me one!
Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!

Hello, hello! I am the official NAME RATER!

Want me to rate the nicknames of your POKéMON?
Which POKéMON should I look at?

POKéMON, is it? That is a decent nickname!

But, would you like me to give it a nicer name?

How about it?
dialog.trigger: If you pick a Pokémon you caught

dialog.text:
Fine! What should we name it?

OK! This POKéMON has been renamed POKéMON!

That's a better name than before!
dialog.trigger: If you say yes, he renames it

dialog.text:
POKéMON, is it? That is a truly impeccable name!

Take good care of POKéMON!
dialog.trigger: If you pick a Pokémon you got in a trade

dialog.text: Fine! Come any time you like!

BLUE: Gramps! I'm fed up with waiting!

OAK: BLUE? Let me think...

Oh, that's right, I told you to come! Just wait!

Here, RED!

There are 3 POKéMON here!

Haha!

They are inside the POKé BALLs.

When I was young, I was a serious POKéMON trainer!

In my old age, I have only 3 left, but you can have one! Choose!

BLUE: Hey! Gramps! What about me?

OAK: Be patient! BLUE, you can have one too!
dialog.trigger: When you follow him into the lab

dialog.text: OAK: Hey! Don't go away yet!
dialog.trigger: If you try to leave without a Pokémon

dialog.text: OAK: Now, RED, which POKéMON do you want?
dialog.trigger: Before you get your first Pokémon

dialog.text: OAK: If a wild POKéMON appears, your POKéMON can fight against it!
dialog.trigger: After you get your first Pokémon

dialog.text: OAK: RED, raise your young POKéMON by making it fight!

OAK: Oh, RED!

How is my old POKéMON?

Well, it seems to like you a lot.

You must be talented as a POKéMON trainer!

What? You have something for me?

RED delivered OAK's PARCEL.

Ah! This is the custom POKé BALL I ordered! Thank you!
dialog.trigger: When you bring Oak's Parcel from the Viridian City Poké Mart

dialog.text:
BLUE: Gramps!

BLUE: What did you call me for?

OAK: Oh right! I have a request of you two.

On the desk there is my invention, POKéDEX!

It automatically records data on POKéMON you've seen or caught!

It's a hi-tech encyclopedia!

OAK: RED and BLUE! Take these with you!

RED got POKéDEX from OAK!

To make a complete guide on all the POKéMON in the world...

That was my dream!

But, I'm too old! I can't do it!

So, I want you two to fulfill my dream for me!

Get moving, you two!

This is a great undertaking in POKéMON history!

BLUE: Alright Gramps! Leave it all to me!

RED, I hate to say it, but I don't need you!

I know! I'll borrow a TOWN MAP from my sis!

I'll tell her not to lend you one, RED! Hahaha!
dialog.trigger: Right after you deliver the parcel

dialog.text: POKéMON around the world wait for you, RED!

OAK: You can't get detailed data on POKéMON by just seeing them.

You must catch them! Use these to capture wild POKéMON.

RED got 5 POKé BALLs!

When a wild POKéMON appears, it's fair game.

Just throw a POKé BALL at it and try to catch it!

This won't always work, though.

A healthy POKéMON could escape. You have to be lucky!
dialog.trigger: After you beat your rival on Route 22, if you have no Poké Balls

dialog.text:
OAK: Come see me sometimes.

I want to know how your POKéDEX is coming along.
OAK: Good to see you! How is your POKéDEX coming? Here, let me take a look!
dialog.trigger: Once you own at least two Pokémon, he rates your Pokédex

dialog.text:
PROF.OAK is the authority on POKéMON!

Many POKéMON trainers hold him in high regard!
I study POKéMON as PROF.OAK's AIDE.
I study POKéMON as PROF.OAK's AIDE.

OAK: Hey! Wait! Don't go out!

OAK: It's unsafe! Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!

You need your own POKéMON for your protection. I know!

Here, come with me!
dialog.trigger: Appears when you try to leave town without a Pokémon

dialog.text:
I'm raising POKéMON too!

When they get strong, they can protect me!

Technology is incredible!

You can now store and recall items and POKéMON as data via PC!

It's rumored that CLEFAIRYs came from the moon!

They appeared after MOON STONE fell on MT.MOON.

There aren't many serious POKéMON trainers here!

They're all like BUG CATCHERs, but PEWTER GYM's BROCK is totally into it!
Did you check out the MUSEUM?
Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON amazing?

Really? You absolutely have to go!

It's right here! You have to pay to get in, but it's worth it! See you around!
dialog.trigger: If you say no, he walks you to the Museum

dialog.text: Psssst! Do you know what I'm doing?
That's right! It's hard work!
I'm spraying REPEL to keep POKéMON out of my garden!

You're a trainer right? BROCK's looking for new challengers! Follow me!

If you have the right stuff, go take on BROCK!
dialog.trigger: When you talk to him, or try to leave east before beating Brock, he walks you to the Gym

dialog.text:
Hiya! I can tell you have what it takes to become a POKéMON champ!

I'm no trainer, but I can tell you how to win!

Let me take you to the top!

All right! Let's get happening!

The 1st POKéMON out in a match is at the top of the POKéMON LIST!

By changing the order of POKéMON, matches could be made easier!

It's a free service! Let's get happening!

The 1st POKéMON out in a match is at the top of the POKéMON LIST!

By changing the order of POKéMON, matches could be made easier!
Just as I thought! You're POKéMON champ material!
Hi there! May I help you?

A shady, old man got me to buy this really weird fish POKéMON!

It's totally weak and it cost ¥500!
Good things can happen if you raise POKéMON diligently, even the weak ones!
NIDORAN: Bowbow!
NIDORAN sit!

Our POKéMON's an outsider, so it's hard to handle.

An outsider is a POKéMON that you get in a trade.

It grows fast, but it may ignore an unskilled trainer in battle!

If only we had some BADGEs...

Welcome to our POKéMON CENTER!

We heal your POKéMON back to perfect health!

Shall we heal your POKéMON?

OK. We'll need your POKéMON.

Thank you! Your POKéMON are fighting fit!

We hope to see you again!
dialog.trigger: If you say yes, she heals your party

dialog.text: We hope to see you again!

What!?

TEAM ROCKET is at MT.MOON? Huh? I'm on the phone!

Scram!
JIGGLYPUFF: Puu pupuu!

This area is reserved for 2 friends who are linked by cable.

Please come again!

POKéMON learn new techniques as they grow!

But, some moves must be taught by the trainer!

POKéMON become easier to catch when they are hurt or asleep!

But, it's not a sure thing!
Won't you admire my PIKACHU's adorable tail?
Humph! My PIKACHU is twice as cute as that one!
dialog.trigger: If you talked to the Seel fan first

dialog.text:
I just love my SEEL!

It squeals when I hug it!

Oh dear!

My SEEL is far more attractive!
dialog.trigger: If you talked to the other fan first

dialog.text: PIKACHU: Chu! Pikachu!
SEEL: Kyuoo!

I chair the POKéMON Fan Club!

I have collected over 100 POKéMON!

I'm very fussy when it comes to POKéMON!

So...

Did you come visit to hear about my POKéMON?

Good! Then listen up!

My favorite RAPIDASH...

It...cute... lovely...smart... plus...amazing... you think so?... oh yes...it... stunning... kindly... love it!

Hug it...when... sleeping...warm and cuddly... spectacular... ravishing... ...Oops! Look at the time! I kept you too long!

Thanks for hearing me out! I want you to have this!

Exchange that for a BICYCLE!

Don't worry, my FEAROW will FLY me anywhere!

So, I don't need a BICYCLE!

I hope you like cycling!
dialog.trigger: If you say yes, he tells his story and gives you a Bike Voucher

dialog.text: Oh. Come back when you want to hear my story!
Make room for this!

Hello, RED!

Did you come see me about my POKéMON again?

No? Too bad!
dialog.trigger: After you get the Bike Voucher

dialog.text: Our Chairman is very vocal about POKéMON.
POKéMON TOWER was erected in the memory of POKéMON that had died.
Did you come to pay respects? Bless you!

I came to pray for my CLEFAIRY.

Sniff! I can't stop crying...
My GROWLITHE... Why did you die?
I am a CHANNELER! There are spirits up to mischief!

Even we could not identify the wayward GHOSTs!

A SILPH SCOPE might be able to unmask them.

Come, child! I sealed this space with white magic!

You can rest here!

MR.FUJI: Heh? You came to save me?

Thank you. But, I came here of my own free will.

I came to calm the soul of CUBONE's mother.

I think MAROWAK's spirit has gone to the afterlife.

I must thank you for your kind concern!

Follow me to my home, POKéMON HOUSE at the foot of this tower.
dialog.trigger: Held by Team Rocket until you beat them, then he takes you to his house

dialog.text:
MOM: Right. All boys leave home some day. It said so on TV.

PROF.OAK, next door, is looking for you.
dialog.trigger: Before you get your first Pokémon

dialog.text:
MOM: RED! You should take a quick rest.

MOM: Oh good! You and your POKéMON are looking great! Take care now!
dialog.trigger: After you get your first Pokémon, she heals your party

dialog.text:
Hi! I work at a POKéMON MART.

It's a convenient shop, so please visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.

I know, I'll give you a sample! Here you go!
dialog.trigger: The first time you talk to him, he gives you a Potion

dialog.text: You have too much stuff with you!
We also carry POKé BALLs for catching POKéMON!

It's a bit scary, but you can jump from them.

You can get back to PALLET TOWN quicker that way.

trade one for NIDORINA?
Awww! Oh well...

If you get one, come back here!

dialog.text: Hey thanks!

dialog.text: Isn't my old NIDORINA great?

Great! You have caught 30 kinds of POKéMON! Congratulations!

Here you go!

dialog.text:
Oh. I see.

When you get 30 kinds, come back for ITEMFINDER.

There are items on the ground that can't be seen.

ITEMFINDER will detect an item close to you.

It can't pinpoint it, so you have to look yourself!

My POKéMON's ashes are stored in POKéMON TOWER.

You can have this TM. I don't need it any more...

RED received TM39!
dialog.trigger: The first time you talk to her, she gives you TM39

dialog.text: You don't have room for this.

I'm the FISHING GURU's brother!

I simply Looove fishing!

Do you like to fish?

Grand! I like your style!

Take this and fish, young one!

RED received a SUPER ROD!

Fishing is a way of life!

From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one!
dialog.trigger: If you say yes, he gives you the Super Rod

dialog.text: Oh... That's so disappointing...

Oh no!

I had a gift for you, but you have no room for it!

Hello there, RED!

Use the SUPER ROD in any water! You can catch different kinds of POKéMON.

Try fishing wherever you can!
dialog.trigger: After you get the Super Rod

dialog.text:
Hi! Remember me? I'm PROF.OAK's AIDE!

If you caught 10 kinds of POKéMON, I'm supposed to give you an HM05!

So, RED! Have you caught at least 10 kinds of POKéMON?

Great! You have caught 10 kinds of POKéMON! Congratulations!
